(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (define reversed? #f)
  (define h (rows g))
  (define w (cols g))
  (define right? (= (at g 0 (- w 1)) 0))
  (define edge (if right? (- w 1) 0))
  (define horizontal? (= (at g 0 (if right? 0 1)) 1))
  (define mask
   (for/list ([r (in-range h)])
    (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
     (if (and (> r 0) (not (= c edge)) (not (= (at g r c) 8))) 1 0))))
  (define bars
   (for/list ([obj (objects mask 0)])
    (let* ([box (obj-bbox obj)] [r0 (first box)] [c0 (second box)] [r1 (third box)] [c1 (fourth box)]
           [x (if right? (- (- w 1) c1) c0)]
           [tile (if horizontal?
                  (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (at g r c)))
                  (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (- c0 1) -1)]) (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (at g r c))))])
     (list (if horizontal? r0 x) (if horizontal? x r0) tile))))
  (define scan-order
   (sort bars (lambda (a b) (or (< (first a) (first b))
                               (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))))
  (define ordered (if reversed? (reverse scan-order) scan-order))
  (define layout-order ordered)
  (define packing-width (apply max (map (lambda (b) (length (first (third b)))) ordered)))
  (apply append
   (for/list ([bar layout-order])
    (let* ([tile (third bar)] [pad (quotient (- packing-width (length (first tile))) 2)])
     (for/list ([row tile]) (append (make-list pad 8) row (make-list pad 8))))))))

(rule!
 ;; Numbered borders define a two-axis reading order from the zero corner.
 ;; Recover multicolor strips against background 8. Rotate vertical strips CCW.
 ;; Walk from index zero, jumping by half the CURRENT normalized strip width.
 ;; Center each retained strip in the maximum retained width and stack tightly.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define left (= (at g 0 0) 0))
   (define vertical (= (at g 1 (if left 0 (- (cols g) 1))) 1))
   (define body (subgrid g 1 (if left 1 0) (- (rows g) 1) (if left (- (cols g) 1) (- (cols g) 2))))
   (define pieces (objects-multicolor body 8))
   (define (secondary o)
    (if vertical (if left (obj-c1 o) (- (obj-c2 o))) (obj-r1 o)))
   (define (primary o)
    (if vertical (obj-r1 o) (if left (obj-c1 o) (- (obj-c2 o)))))
   (define ordered
    (sort pieces (lambda (a b)
     (or (< (secondary a) (secondary b))
         (and (= (secondary a) (secondary b)) (< (primary a) (primary b)))))))
   (define tiles
    (map (lambda (o)
     (let ((piece (subgrid body (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o))))
      (if vertical (rotate-ccw piece) piece))) ordered))
   (define steps (map (lambda (tile) (quotient (cols tile) 2)) tiles))
   (define indices (let loop ((i 0) (visited '()))
    (if (>= i (length tiles)) (reverse visited)
        (loop (+ i (list-ref steps i)) (cons i visited)))))
   (define chosen (map (lambda (i) (list-ref tiles i)) indices))
   (define width (apply max (map cols chosen)))
   (build-grid (* 2 (length chosen)) width (r c)
    (let* ((tile (list-ref chosen (quotient r 2)))
           (offset (quotient (- width (cols tile)) 2)))
     (if (and (>= c offset) (< c (+ offset (cols tile))))
         (at tile (modulo r 2) (- c offset)) 8))))))
